context: Request: top five clients by number of matters, with counts, for a relationship review. Rubric names no matter numbers: counts per client (Lumos 1008, Cascade Retail 1038, Quorum 1025 at 10; Dunmore 1016, Aurelius 1017, Penterra 1018 at 9) and tie handling.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the silent cap.

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store; prints all matter folder names, then find | grep over file paths for engagement and intake files (about 86K chars). The review flags the truncated output and the name filter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Extraction script pulling the opening text of engagement or intake documents for every matter (two matters have none), a count of folders per matter-number prefix, and greps of the extract for the six largest prefixes. The review flags that client identity was inferred from the prefix.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Per-prefix extraction of a client-identifying opening (the first script fails on a heredoc), file listings and text of the two matters without engagement files, and per-prefix matter lists for the leading groups.
Writes six clients (three tied at 10 matters, three at 9) with matter-number ranges and source documents. The review flags an apparent inconsistency in the tie wording.
Re-reads the response and checks that the six cited paths exist.
Recomputes the six counts from the folder list. The review flags the prefix-to-client assumption.
Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for a document type → Scan document text with an extraction script → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a listing of all matter folders with a count and the engagement files (labelled by the declared intent).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Extraction script over engagement and matter-opening documents of every matter, a count of folders per prefix, and samples for the six largest groups. The review flags the file-name filter and prefix-based counting.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide search for the six client names: the first per-range scripts time out, a faster text extractor over three matter ranges completes and shows each name only in its own prefix group.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads nine engagement letters and one memo from the six leading groups to confirm the client names.
Computes per-prefix counts from the folder list and pulls source references for the six groups. The review flags that prefixes are treated as clients.
Writes six clients (three tied at 10, three at 9) with all 57 matter numbers and source documents.
Re-reads the response, checks cited paths and the folder count. The review flags inconsistent tie wording.
An edit first rejected because no stage was open, then the same tie-wording edit after a new stage_start, and a partial re-read.
A further edit of the tie wording.
Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Scan document text with an extraction script → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Calculate figures for the answer → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the silent cap.
declared: List files in the document store; prints all 266 matter folder names.

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: Per-matter scan for engagement and opening files, sample text extraction from them, and a count of folders per prefix.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing; scripts extracting the openings of engagement documents of the eleven largest prefix groups, plus a grep of the engagement list for six of them.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Search within a candidate matter's files; store-wide extraction script counting where each of the six client names appears. The review flags that most matters showed none of the names.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing; a script sampling one client-identifying document per prefix group, then reads of six engagement letters (labelled by the dominant intent).
Writes six clients (three tied at 10, three at 9) with all matter numbers of the leading groups and source documents.
Re-reads the response and lists the files of the six cited matters.
Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for a document type → Search within a candidate matter's files → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

divergence: All three runs passed with the same procedure: enumerate all matter folders, count folders per matter-number prefix, confirm the client name of each leading group from engagement-letter text (scripts or reads), and report six clients with the three-way tie at 9 matters. Every review from the scan stage onward flagged treating the prefix as the client and asked for per-matter attribution; none of the runs did that, and the answers still passed. Reviews also pushed tie-wording edits in T0 and T1.
